title: Credit Score Myth Busted

scenes.text: Your score can drop 100 points after one missed payment on a $5,000 loan
scenes.query: credit score drop after missed payment

scenes.text: People believe any credit‑card balance above 30% usage instantly ruins a credit score.
scenes.label: 30% Utilization Myth

scenes.text: FICO scores weight utilization about 10%; payment history, length of credit, and mix have larger impact, so a temporary 40% balance rarely causes a huge drop.
scenes.label: Utilization Small Factor

scenes.text: Keep payments on time and let old accounts age – that’s the real boost.
scenes.label: Pay On Time
scenes.query: importance of on‑time payments credit score

scenes.text: Follow if you're done staying broke.

description: We debunk the 30% utilization myth and show what truly moves your score. Simple steps you can apply today.
